dedupe_keys.name: acer remit inside information access point eu urgent market messages on power and gas outages from 23 inside information platforms

description: Under REMIT, the EU regulation on wholesale energy market integrity and transparency, market participants must publish inside information, such as planned and unplanned outages, reduced capacity and maintenance of production, storage and transmission facilities, on inside information platforms approved by ACER, while trades and fundamental data are reported confidentially to ACER for market surveillance. ACER, the EU agency for the cooperation of energy regulators, runs the Inside Information Access Point as a single public gateway to those disclosures. Coverage: the European Union's electricity and gas markets; urgent market messages collected from 23 approved platforms on outages, service interruptions and maintenance events affecting gas and electricity production, transmission and consumption, for events in the past five years, excluding the last two days (last updated 26 September 2026 when read). Format and access: a web search interface on the REMIT portal behind a captcha, in beta; free; the confidential transaction, LNG and fundamental data reported through registered reporting mechanisms are not public. Licence: ACER copyright, all rights reserved per the portal footer; reuse terms not stated. Caveats: ACER warns the data may contain duplicates and inaccuracies, depends on each platform's feed format, and some fields (for example multiple capacity intervals) exist only for messages collected after 2 March 2024; the data behind the captcha were not opened. Simulation uses: historical outage and capacity reduction events of power plants, pipelines and interconnectors for cascading failure, resilience and capacity planning studies of European energy systems. Related records: the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform (data-entsoe-transparency-platform) also publishes generation and transmission unavailability for electricity.
